metadata.name: Global central carbon metabolism
metadata.description: Glycolysis, the oxidative pentose phosphate pathway and the TCA cycle in one figure. Maps onto any reasonably annotated GEM.

scope.note: Universal core; the TCA part is mitochondrial in eukaryotes.

compartments.note: The TCA cycle is mitochondrial in eukaryotes; prokaryote-like models run it in the cytoplasm.
